name: maybe_Container_WalkSubtreeInvokeVisitor

The function stores nothing, so it dispatches a visitor over the subtree instead of unlinking it.

name: Math_EaseCurve_Vec2Sine
signature: void Math_EaseCurve_Vec2Sine(float2* out, const float2* from, const float2* to, float t, float duration)
summary: Writes out = from + to * ease(t * duration) for two float2 vectors: the eased factor comes from the scalar helper 0x00673BC8, and the sibling Math_EaseCurve_Mode01 (0x006F4898) feeds that same helper (t/duration) * pi/2, i.e. a sine ease.
